ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Call To Win32_NTEventlogFile Class
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the WMI class "Win32_NTEventlogFile" in a potentially suspicious way (delete, backup, change permissions, etc.) from a PowerShell script

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*Win32\\_NTEventlogFile.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.BackupEventlog\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ChangeSecurityPermissions\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ChangeSecurityPermissionsEx\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ClearEventLog\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.Delete\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.DeleteEx\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.Rename\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.TakeOwnerShip\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.TakeOwnerShipEx\\(.*")))
